preserve: STOP drain and post-STOP DONE suppression
supersedes_next: Immediate NES364 host ABI 3314-to843 implementation before integration/capture cadence proof

phases.objective: Materialize and pin a single candidate; use the same board admission/context/port connections in functional simulation and synthesis.
required: Separate current capture context from display context
Correct source launch/lifetime and STOP drain ownership
Exercise actual collector query rather than fixed epoch/current generation injection
Cold/warm/next-capture-overlap/STOP/final-ACK/epoch-generation rollover guards
phases.exit: No test-only bypass of source admission; same generated top and complete artifact manifest. No hardware or 60fps claim.

phases.objective: Prove capture rearm and display deadlines using continuous PPU cadence and actual or justified worst-case ROM demand during both source input and output.
required: Investigate 2.838466ms source input versus at-most 2.340517ms model rearm window
Continuous frame IDs and capture N+1/output N overlap
Actual ARM source/hint foreground, IRQ and shared SPI
Actual 65816 service, DMA/poll/VBlank/final ACK
First capture rearm case, then heavy7 and 71-frame whole path
Independent phase sweep and continuous schedule
Startup versus gameplay cold/STOP recovery policy
metrics: capture start interval and missed capture count
display period and repeated/dropped frame IDs
phases.exit: No unexplained missed capture/display deadline or unbounded backlog; benchmark scope and hardware-clock assumptions explicit. Oversized RTL simulation is allowed, hardware claim is not.

phases.objective: Choose one broad, justified implementation deletion based on the validated schedule and RAM lifetime.
required: Audit retained11391 and resource-only wrapper versus required product functionality
Replace actual old bodies rather than add a second engine
Direct actual ARM serializer and new receiver including every fragment credit/status response
Independent verification and STOP/final ACK preserved
Whole Quartus Lite cost on the same implementation

budget.note: Recompute after capture/port integration. 843 is not a demonstrated feasible design.

phases.exit: Same candidate meets sustained timing and whole resource budget. If it fails, reconsider representation/roles/hardware feasibility; do not enter small-FSM/opcode/seed loops.

phases.objective: Build and test a matching FPGA/ARM/SNES candidate on the existing board.
required: Whole FIT and STA
New CDC, external IO and clock review
Pinned bitstream/firmware/65816 artifacts
Boot smoke then sustained scroll/audio/input/menu/STOP/save validation
Actual regional display cadence and frame-ID/drop/repeat measurements
phases.exit: Measured sustained hardware cadence with recorded worst-case latency and zero unexplained loss/corruption.
